actions.title: Configure physical iOS + Android device provider
actions.why: V4 adds sustained-pressure/thermal proxy, sector visibility and texture budgets, but emulation is not physical-device evidence.
actions.automation: Configure REAL_DEVICE_PROVIDER_URL/TOKEN and run sustained tests on real iPhone + Android.

actions.title: Enable write-capable winner-only PR bot
actions.why: V4 candidate lab, learner, scheduler, patch tournament and gates are ready for branch-only automation.
actions.automation: Grant branch/PR credentials; never push master and never auto-merge.

actions.title: Connect verified semantic texture baker
actions.why: Procedural PBR parameters are ready, but high-frequency authored normal/roughness/AO textures should come from a verified backend.
actions.automation: Route generated maps through candidate hashes, memory budgets and visual baseline gate; never auto-approve.

actions.title: Add WebGPU meshlet path as optional experiment
actions.why: Current WebGL greedy/HLOD/sector visibility is mature; meshlets may improve huge scenes on supported devices.
actions.automation: Keep WebGL as fallback and promote WebGPU only after browser/device evidence wins the candidate tournament.
